name: fal-ai
description: fal.ai: run any fal model through the queue (waits for the result, saves media files), check, fetch or cancel requests, search models and prices (paid per run)

nodes.title: Run model
nodes.description: Run a fal model through the queue and wait for the result (paid), e.g. model_id fal-ai/flux/schnell. Media URLs in the result are saved to $FAL_AI_OUTPUT_DIR

model_id.description: Model endpoint id, optionally with a sub-path, e.g. fal-ai/flux/dev or fal-ai/flux-pro/v1.1-ultra

input.description: Model inputs from the model's API page, e.g. {"prompt": "a red fox", "image_size": "landscape_4_3"}

priority.description: Queue priority within your own queue (default normal)

start_timeout.description: Give up (504) if no runner starts within this many seconds

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get request status
nodes.description: Status of a queued request: IN_QUEUE (with queue_position), IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED (with error and error_type when it failed)

owner.description: First part of the model id, e.g. fal-ai

app.description: Second part of the model id without any sub-path, e.g. flux for fal-ai/flux/dev

logs.description: 1 to include logs (only for the app owner)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get request result
nodes.description: Result of a completed request (kept 1 hour, or 6 minutes when 10 KB or larger); media URLs are saved to $FAL_AI_OUTPUT_DIR

owner.description: First part of the model id, e.g. fal-ai

app.description: Second part of the model id without any sub-path, e.g. flux for fal-ai/flux/dev

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Cancel request
nodes.description: Cancel a queued request (it never runs) or ask a running one to stop; repeating it is harmless

owner.description: First part of the model id, e.g. fal-ai

app.description: Second part of the model id without any sub-path, e.g. flux for fal-ai/flux/dev

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Search models
nodes.description: Search fal model endpoints by text or category, or look up specific endpoint ids (with their OpenAPI schema when expanded)

q.description: Free-text search over name, description and category

status.description: Only active or deprecated models (default both)

endpoint_id.description: Look up these endpoint ids, e.g. [fal-ai/flux/dev]

expand.description: openapi-3.0 adds each model's input/output schema

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get pricing
nodes.description: Unit price of model endpoints (per image, video second, megapixel or GPU second) for your account

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Estimate cost
nodes.description: Estimate the cost of planned calls (historical_api_price: per call) or outputs (unit_price: per billing unit)

estimate_type.description: historical_api_price takes call_quantity, unit_price takes unit_quantity

endpoints.description: Endpoint ids to quantities, e.g. {"fal-ai/flux/dev": {"unit_quantity": 50}} or {"fal-ai/flux/dev": {"call_quantity": 100}}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
